Description.description: An action required because a check produced a non-pass outcome (BR-006). The adviser completes it and the T&C Manager validates Insufficient evidence and Potential harm (BR-008, AD-020, AD-031). Validation outcomes and sign-off are recorded on al_Signoff, and initial/final outcomes on al_Outcome (Wave H).
Progress of the remediation action. Validation and rejection are recorded on al_Signoff by the T&C Manager (AD-031); this status tracks the adviser's completion only.
Progress of the action: Open, In progress or Completed. The adviser drives it to Completed (BR-008); T&C Manager validation and sign-off are recorded on al_Signoff (AD-031).

What the adviser did about this action, in their own words (FR-020, FR-021). Written from the portal, which is where the whole remediation loop runs (AD-045). Recorded separately from al_description so the instruction and the answer to it are never confused.

Portal identity of the adviser responsible for this remediation action (AD-047). Set server-side at assignment from the work-email join (OD-003, AD-010). Contact-scoped Power Pages access binds to this; systemuser ownership is unchanged.
When the adviser marked the action complete. Empty until completion. Preserving this alongside the initial outcome supports BR-007.
Whether the adviser has asked for this action to be marked complete.

The portal's completion trigger, mirroring al_reviewinstance.al_submitrequested (AD-073). A page cannot call the al_CompleteRemediation action, so the adviser sets this and CompleteRequestPlugin runs the command. Setting it is a request: the status transition, the mandatory response and the audit event are all decided server-side.
What the adviser must do to remediate the finding. Drawn from the non-pass outcome that triggered the action (BR-006).
Date the action is due. Feeds remediation ageing MI under BR-010.
Reference to the supporting document in Intelligent Office (PP-14, AD-046). A reference only: no evidence is uploaded to or stored by the portal, so this is the whole of PP-14.
Short label identifying the remediation action in lists.
Each remediation action belongs to one case. Restrict delete preserves the remediation record and its outcomes so both the initial and final outcome survive under BR-007.
Stable business code for the action. Alternate key, so generating the same action twice upserts rather than duplicating under NFR-REL-01 (AD-014).
Unique identifier for the remediation action.
The review instance whose non-pass outcome triggered this remediation action (BR-006). Optional because an action can be raised at case level. Restrict delete keeps the trigger traceable.
